affected_subject.reason: Identifies TrailsRouter.injectAndCall function and router-held ERC20 balances.

trigger_or_action.reason: Any caller invoking injectAndCall with an arbitrary target forwards router balance.

direct_effect.reason: Pooled/stranded ERC20 balances are forwarded out to caller-chosen target, draining router.

safety_relation_basis.reason: No link between assets spent and caller; expected authorization/ownership relation violated.

summary: Fragments identify the vulnerable function, the trigger (any caller forwarding router balance to arbitrary target), the direct drain effect, and the missing authorization relation between assets and caller.
